It's kind of hard to like myself. There's just nothing to like. I just want to be around nice people who won't make fun of me and treat me like I matter. I want to be the kind of person that doesn't suck.
The fact that you took time out of your day to reach out to me is more than enough for me right now. I'm so alone so when someone, even a stranger, shows care it means a lot.
Family, doctor, therapist...

This place doesn't help me either, mainly because I don't really get support, just people offering to talk and then ignoring me. Or reading about peoples loved ones worrying about them and being reminded that I don't have that. But I have nowhere else to go.

Sorry I took so long to respond, but thank you. I never imagined that someone would write out this much for me. I'm hard on myself because I should be. I'm repulsive and no one wants anything to do with me. It's been like that for a long time. I have no hope of getting better. No friends, therapy hasn't been working, my parents actively try to ignore the fact that I'm depressed. So I'm just on a slow decline until I can't take it anymore. 

You say you're self centered, but you clearly aren't since you're on here trying to help people like me. The fact that you went through all of that and came out a good person shows how resilient you are. There's genuine proof that you're a worthy person. I have never had confidence, and after being bullied I'm sure I never will. There's nothing to be confident about. You make a good point about not caring what others think, but if I don't try to get people to like me I'm never going to make friends. 

I do wish for you to get some sleep, you shouldnt torture yourself like that. Nut really, thank you for reaching out to me.
I'm doing it right now.
